name: Dreadforger (Combat)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Craft (any) 5 ranks.

Benefit(s): When creating a non-magical trap, poison, or other item which is not gained from a class ability, feat or sphere, you may increase the saving throw DC of the item to up to 10 + 1/2 your character level + your Intelligence modifier. For every point by which you increase the saving throw DC, the Craft DC increases by 2. Using this feat does not increase the cost of your creation.
